title: Why Most Enterprise Agent Pilots Never Reach Deployment
summary: Research reveals that 89% of enterprise AI agent pilots fail to reach production deployment, despite 78% of enterprises running at least one pilot. Only 14% have scaled agents organization-wide, highlighting a significant gap between pilot adoption and actual deployment.
problem_solved: Examines why enterprise AI agent pilots fail to transition from experimentation to full-scale production deployment.
why_valuable: Provides critical insights into the practical challenges of scaling AI agents in enterprise environments, helping organizations understand and address barriers to production deployment.
